name: Certification, Authentication and Verification
description: Official verification and authentication of academic documents for local or international use, commonly required for employment, further studies, or legal purposes.

name: Certificate of Graduation
description: Certifies that a student has successfully completed all academic requirements and has officially graduated from the institution.

name: Certificate of Enrolment
description: Confirms that a student is currently enrolled in a specific academic term, including program and year level details.

name: Certification of Earned Units
description: Indicates the total number of academic units a student has successfully completed in their program.

name: Certification of Completed Academic Requirements
description: Certifies that a student has fulfilled all academic requirements but may not yet have formally graduated.

name: Certification of Honor Graduate
description: Confirms that a graduate has received academic honors such as cum laude, magna cum laude, or summa cum laude.

name: Certificate of Course Description
description: Provides detailed descriptions of courses taken, including topics covered, often required for credit transfer or evaluation abroad.

name: Certificate of ID Issuance
description: Certifies that a student or alumnus has been issued an official school identification card.

name: Certificate of NSTP Serial Number
description: Confirms the assigned NSTP serial number of a student, typically required for compliance with national service records.

name: Certificate of GWA
description: Certifies the General Weighted Average (GWA) of a student for a specific period or entire academic program.

name: Certificate of Transfer Credentials
description: Indicates that a student is eligible to transfer to another institution and has no outstanding obligations.

name: Certification of Grades
description: Provides an official record of a student’s grades for a specific term or entire academic history.

name: Certificate of English Medium
description: Certifies that the medium of instruction used in the student’s academic program is English, often required for international studies or employment.
